content: Yinni Gusunɔ u nɛɛ,
tɔnun bii, ɑ Eɡibitiɡibu ɡerusio kpɑ ɑ bu sɔ̃ ɑ nɛɛ, ɑmɛniwɑ nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔ nɑ ɡeruɑ. Nɑ nɛɛ, wee tɔ̃ɔ kɔ̃surɑ wee. Bu weeweenu koowo.
Tɔ̃ɔ te, tɑ sisi tè sɔɔ nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔ kon bu wɔri. Wee tɑ mɑm turuku kuɑ. Tɑ ko n sɑ̃ɑwɑ yɑm wɔ̃kuru.
Tɑbu koo nɑ Eɡibitiɔ kpɑ bu tɔn dɑbiru ɡo mi, bu ben dukiɑ ɡurɑ kpɑ tem mɛ, mu ko bɑnsu, kpɑ nuku sɑnkirɑ bɑkɑnu nu n wɑ̃ɑ Etiopiɔ.
Etiopiɡibu kɑ Putiɡibu kɑ Ludibɑ kɑ Dɑɑrububɑ kpuro kɑ Libiɡibu kɑ sere mɑɑ nɛn tɔmbu Isireli be bɑ kɑ bu nɔɔ tiɑ sɑ̃ɑ bɑ koo wɔruku bu ɡbisuku tɑɑ bi sɔɔ.

Nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔ nɑ mɑɑ ɡeruɑ nɑ nɛɛ, be bɑ kɑ Eɡibitiɡibu yinɑmɔ mi, bɑ koo bu ɡo tɑbu sɔɔ sɑɑ Miɡidolin di n kɑ ɡirɑri Asuɑniɔ kpɑ dɑm mɛ Eɡibitiɡibu bɑ rɑɑ kɑ tii sue mi, mu kpe. Nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔwɑ nɑ yeni ɡeruɑ.
Ben tem mɛ, mu koo ko bɑnsu n kere tem mɛ n tie hɑnduniɑ sɔɔ. Ben wusu su koo kowɑ bɑnsu mɑm mɑm n kere wuu si su tie.
Nɑ̀ n Eɡibitiɡibu dɔ̃ɔ sɔkumɑ mɑ nɑ derɑ be bɑ kɑ bu yinɑmɔ min dɑm mu kpɑ, sɑɑ ye sɔɔrɑ bɑ koo ɡiɑ mɑ nɛnɑ nɑ sɑ̃ɑ Yinni Gusunɔ.
Yen tɔ̃ɔ te sɔɔ, kon sɔmɔbu ɡɔri ɡoo nimkusu sɔɔ bu Etiopiɡii be bɑ rɑɑ wɑ̃ɑ bɔri yɛndu sɔɔ nɑndɑsiɑ kpɑ bu bɛrum soorɑ Eɡibitiɡibun wɑhɑlɑn tɔ̃ɔ te sɔɔ, te tɑ sisi.
Nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔ nɑ nɛɛ, kon sinɑ boko Nɛbukɑnɛsɑɑ dendi n kɑ Eɡibitin tɔn dɑbi te kpuro kpeerɑsiɑ.
Wi, kɑ win tɑbu kowo wɔnwɔndu sɑriruɡii be, bɑ koo nɑ bu tem mɛ wɔri bu kpeerɑsiɑ. Bɑ koo Eɡibitiɡibu ɡo kɑ tɑkobi kpɑ ɡonu nu yibu tem mɛ kpuro sɔɔ.
Kon de dɑɑ te bɑ mɔ̀ Nilun kɛri yi ɡberɑ kpɑ n Eɡibitin tem tɔn kɔ̃sobu nɔmu bɛriɑ. Tɔn tukobu bɑ koo nɑ bu ye kpuro kɑm koosiɑ. Nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔwɑ nɑ yeni ɡeruɑ.
Nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔ nɑ mɑɑ ɡeruɑ nɑ nɛɛ, kon Nɔfun bũu turɑnun bwɑ̃ɑrokunu kpuro kɔsuku. Goo kun mɑɑ bɑndu dimɔ Eɡibitiɔ. Kon dewɑ tem mɛ, mu bɛrum duurɑ.
Kon Pɑturɔsi kpeerɑsiɑ kpɑ n Soɑni dɔ̃ɔ mɛni kpɑ n mɑɑ Tebɛsi siri.
Kon kɑ Sini mɔru ko ye, ye yɑ sɑ̃ɑ nɡe Eɡibitiɡibun ɡbɑ̃rɑ bɑkɑru kpɑ n Tebɛsin tɔn dɑbi dɑbi te ɡo.
Kon Eɡibiti dɔ̃ɔ sɔku kpɑ Sini yu burisinɑ. Bɑ koo Tebɛsin ɡbɑ̃rɑru kɔrɑ kpɑ yibɛrɛbɑ bu Nɔfu kɑmiɑ sɔ̃ɔ sɔɔ ɡbɑ̃ɑrɑ.
Bɑ koo Onin ɑluwɑɑsibɑ kɑ Pibesɛtiɡibu ɡo kɑ tɑkobi. Wuu si kpuron tɔmbɑ bɑ koo yoru mwɑ.
Nɑ̀ n Eɡibitiɡibun dɑm buɑ mɛ bɑ mɔ bɑ kɑ tɔmbu yoru diisie, mɑ dɑm mɛ bɑ rɑɑ kɑ tii sue mi, mu nɔru kuɑ, yɑm mu koo tĩrɑ Tɑpɑnɛsiɔ kpɑ bu yen tɔmbu yoru mwɛɛri.
Kon Eɡibitiɡibu siri kpɑ bu ɡiɑ mɑ nɛnɑ nɑ sɑ̃ɑ Yinni Gusunɔ.
Bɑbilonin sinɑ boko
u sɑ̃ɑwɑ Gusunɔn denditiɑ
Isirelibɑn yorun wɔ̃ɔ wɔkurɑ tiɑsen suru ɡbiikoon sɔ̃ɔ nɔɔbɑ yiruse sɔɔrɑ Yinni Gusunɔ u ɡeruɑ u nɛɛ,
tɔnun bii, nɑ Eɡibitin sunɔn ɡɑ̃seru buɑ. Wee, bɑ ǹ wɑ wi u koo nùn bɛkiɑ. Domi bɑ ǹ win mɛɛrɑ ye bɔkue u sere nɛɛ, u koo kpĩ u tɑkobi nɛnɛ.
Wee nɑ Eɡibitin sunɔ wi wɔrim wee. Kon win ɡɑ̃senu kpuro bɔɔku te tɑ ɡeɑ sɑ̃ɑ kɑ te tɑ ǹ ɡeɑ sɑ̃ɑ. Kon de tɑkobi yu wɔrumɑ win nɔmɑn di.
Kon Eɡibitiɡibu yɑrinɑsiɑ bu dɑ bwese tukunun suunu sɔɔ. Kon de bu dɑ tem bɑɑmɛre sɔɔ.
Kon Bɑbilonin sinɑ boko dɑm wɛ̃ kpɑ n nùn nɛn tɑkobi nɔmu bɛriɑ. Adɑmɑ kon Eɡibitin sunɔn ɡɑ̃seru buɑ kpɑ u weeweenu ko Bɑbilonin sinɑ bokon wuswɑɑɔ nɡe u ɡɔɔ dɔɔ.
Kon Bɑbilonin sinɑ boko dɑm wɛ̃ kpɑ Eɡibitin sinɑ bokoɡim mu kpe. Nɑ̀ n nɛn tɑkobi Bɑbilonin sinɑ boko nɔmu bɛriɑ, mɑ u kɑ ye Eɡibitiɡibu wɔri, sɑɑ ye sɔɔrɑ bɑ koo ɡiɑ mɑ nɛnɑ nɑ sɑ̃ɑ Yinni Gusunɔ.
Kon Eɡibitiɡibu yɑrinɑsiɑ bu dɑ bwesenu kpuro sɔɔ. Kon dewɑ bu dɑ tem bɑɑmɛre sɔɔ. Sɑɑ ye sɔɔrɑ bɑ koo ɡiɑ mɑ nɛnɑ nɑ sɑ̃ɑ Yinni Gusunɔ.
Eɡibitin sinɑ boko u sɑ̃ɑwɑ
nɡe dɑ̃ɑ ye bɑ mɔ̀ sɛduru
